The global projection Π ℓ T in L 2 ( T h ) onto P ℓ ( T h ) is then given by (Π ℓ T v ) | K = Π ℓ K ( v | K ) for all K ∈ T h . Similarly, the global projection Π ℓ F in L 2 ( F h ) onto P ℓ ( F h ) is given, separately for all F ∈ F h , by (Π ℓ F ˆ v ) | F = Π ℓ F (ˆ v | F ), where Π ℓ F is the L 2 ( F ) orthogonal projection onto P ℓ ( F ). In the following, we maintain the notation Π ℓ T to refer to the L 2 -orthogonal projection onto P ℓ ( T h , R m × n ). Similarly, we will also use Π ℓ F to denote the L 2 orthogonal projection onto P ℓ ( F h , R m × n ).
